subject: social_studies
concept: Understanding scale of governance: a school, a town, and a country each have their own kind of leadership and rules
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student identifies the leadership structure of their own school or class
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a scale (school, town, country) to an example of leadership at that scale
exercise.abstract: Student explains how leadership at a small scale (like a classroom) is similar to and different from leadership at a large scale (like a country)

misconception_flags: believes leadership only exists at the national level, missing smaller-scale examples

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
